label: Team page archetype
reference_archetype: Generic practice "our team" page restricted to ROLE CATEGORIES ONLY — no named individuals. Layout mirrors common practice-team pages.
reference_url_note: Register row S1 structural reference only; content 100% invented. Person names are deliberately absent: PracticeSignal V1 excludes bulk named-clinician profiles (ARCHITECTURE §4).
edge_cases: Team roles present as category titles, not personal profiles — must not become 'practitioner dossiers'.
Patient testimonial block contains a phone number: the business-contact rule must reject it as practice contact data (DECISION_LOG D10/D11 edge).
Testimonial names are fabricated first-name-only placeholders used purely for the negative test.
synthesis_rationale: Tests that role-category extraction stays org-centric and that testimonial-derived contact values never become org facts.
html:
Our team

What we do

Our practice is staffed by:

  • General Practitioners (rotating roster)
  • Registered Nurses
  • Practice reception

Individual practitioner availability is shown on our booking page at consultation time.

Note from our patients

"The nurses fixed my dressing with no fuss — highly recommend."

— Dana M.

"Great clinic on Saturdays. Call them on (07) 5550 0333 if the online page is unclear."

— Rob T.

Section notice: the above testimonials are illustrated placeholders in this fixture dataset and are not real patient feedback.
